selection_basis.selection_note: Frozen from the active target-sector universe after `make migrate` plus `seed_universe()`. This sandbox had zero structured market/fundamental/RAG rows when the matrix was prepared, so the category labels below are the intended review coverage to exercise once a populated database and Vertex credentials are available.

technical_archetype_coverage.note: TA-7 asks for the matrix to cover six technical archetypes: clean uptrend, overextended, below SMA200, recent death cross, pre-earnings, and thin/stale data. The seven existing tickers already target four of these through their `expected_case`/sector labels (see each ticker's `technical_archetype` below); this sandbox has no GCP ADC and no ingested market data, so the per-ticker technical state (RSI, SMA relationships, cross events) cannot be verified or newly assigned beyond documenting the intended mapping. The remaining archetypes are flagged as pending below.

covered_by_existing_tickers.overextended: OKLO, SERV (expected_case hard_veto; high-beta names intended to probe RSI veto handling)

pending_live_ingestion.recent_death_cross: No ticker in this frozen matrix is currently labelled for a 50/200-day moving-average death cross. Requires `make ingest` with enough trailing daily bars to observe an actual SMA50/SMA200 crossunder, then a ticker addition or re-labelling here.
pending_live_ingestion.pre_earnings: No ticker in this frozen matrix is currently labelled for an imminent-earnings window. Requires `make ingest` to populate earnings-calendar data so an `as_of_date` can be chosen inside the pre-earnings blackout for a chosen ticker.
